description: A daily cross-sectional momentum pipeline with five planted lookaheads. Each one is a value that could not have been computed at the bar it is attached to.

expected.note: reversal_1d is the next session's return, attached to today's row.
gap_next reads tomorrow's open against today's close.
A 21-bar centred rolling mean draws ten bars from after t.
Backward-filling book_to_price carries a later filing into rows that predate it.
The z-score divides by the whole column's mean and standard deviation.
StandardScaler is fitted on the full panel before the walk-forward split.
